Smart Procurement Navigator (International Edition) v1.1.0-intl

- Initial release of the international edition with dual-track procurement system covering China and international frameworks.
- Supports the full procurement lifecycle including opportunity identification, bid assessment, document interpretation, compliance review, and knowledge reuse.
- Includes detailed process coverage for 12 core business steps, from market development to final bid submission.
- Provides contact information, licensing terms, and mandatory output standards for every response.
- Incorporates a summary of relevant Chinese bidding and procurement legal frameworks and recent policy updates.
